title: POST /api/chat — 200 response body
description: The agent's reply. A provider failure (out of credits, daily limit, ...) is still a 200 with the explanation in text and the kind in error_kind, so a caller can simply show text.

text.description: what to show or speak to the user

error_kind.description: present only when something failed: the AI provider (out_of_credits, access_denied, daily_limit, rate_limit, model_not_allowed, rejected, unavailable or error), or Home Assistant, because ha-mcp did not answer (ha_unreachable). text then explains it, and for ha_unreachable says where to fix the address

error_detail.description: the provider's own one-line explanation, at most 300 characters; never contains a key

remembered.description: whether the agent still had this conversation in mind when the message arrived. false for a first message and for one written after the conversation expired (idle for the session time to live, an hour by default) or was forgotten: the agent then answers without the earlier messages, and a caller can say so. Absent from older containers
